hook.text: Tough beef chuck becomes meltingly tender after hours of braising. Collagen is converting to gelatin.

buildup.text: Collagen is the most abundant protein in animals—it builds connective tissue, skin, and bones.

discovery.text: Above 70°C, collagen's triple-helix structure unwinds into gelatin. Gelatin dissolves in liquid and thickens it.

twist.text: That's why slow-cooked stews feel rich and silky. Dissolved gelatin gives body that butter or cream can't match.

climax.text: Jello, gummy bears, and panna cotta all rely on gelatin setting into a gel when cooled.

punchline.text: Heat turns tough meat tender. Collagen becomes gelatin—science you can taste.
